Rwanda.outcome_summary: Two decades stability, no turnover; HDI 0.189(1994)->0.578(2023); strong growth; tight political control (VA -0.53). Neither falsification condition met.

a_trajectory.evidence: realized stability + development; composite P1 0.582 predicts correctly
a_trajectory.explanation: Decomposition would have biased toward a fragility miscall the record refutes.

f_reversal_risk.explanation: Logged as open prospective forecast, not a closed win.

new_failure_modes_discovered: high-capacity/low-voice latent reversal risk not captured by current Safeguard C
